questions.notes: Sectoral poll: respondents are the religious-Zionist (הזרם הדתי-לאומי) sector only, so pct is per sector, not national; no seat column at all (seats null, seats_total null). This is the only vote-intention question in the PDF and it is a scenario (Religious Zionism + Zehut merged list, party set to the larger component הציונות הדתית), marked as main per spec rule 6. N=484 for this question (the other questions have N=508). not_voting_pct row is 'אף אחת מהמפלגות / לא מתכוון/ת להצביע' (1%); undecided row is 'טרם החלטתי / לא יודע/ת' (13%). Pcts are whole numbers as shown.

extraction_notes: All 7 pages readable. Header: 'סקר בקרב משרתי מילואים – ynet וידיעות אחרונות – 04/09/2026' (title says reservists but the population row says national sample of the religious-Zionist stream, 18+; Q1 confirms respondents identify as דתי-לאומי/ציונות דתית/חרד"ל). Fieldwork 31/08/2026–01/09/2026, internet panel, random sampling, initial sample 500 (row 'גודל המדגם ההתחלתי') while 2,849 were invited (recorded as initial_sample), 508 actually participated; after the Religious Zionism–Zehut merger was announced the survey was re-distributed to all 508 with a new question and 484 answered it. Response rate 17%, refusal 83% (2,341), margin ±4.3%. Questions 1-7 (identity, attitudes to government policies, most important issue, whether a political home exists) are not vote-intention and were skipped. Q1 table has yellow-highlighted rows with 'סוננו' (filtered) for דתל"שים, דתי ליברלי, דתי לייט, אחר. No text dump file exists for this ref. Seat sum check not applicable: table has no seats.
